abs_road_surface.definition: The material under the tyre: tarmac, concrete, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice or leaves.
abs_road_surface.example: The road surface was loose gravel, so a locked wheel was the shorter stop.

att_attachment.definition: A file sent together with the email. It should be named clearly and referred to in the body.
att_attachment.example: Please find the attachment, called Quotation-March-2026.pdf.

eco_mode.definition: The car is in an economy mode: it saves fuel, and often responds more gently. Severity level 1 — Information / Status. Action: Nothing to do..

intelill_self_assessment.definition: Judging your own work or your own ability.
intelill_self_assessment.example: Self-assessment told him he was ready; the job in front of him said otherwise.

mathlit_proof.definition: The written record of a reasoning, in which every line follows from the lines above it.
mathlit_proof.example: The proof is short, and any reader can check it line by line.
